name: Cserszegtomaj (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of medium blue over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Cserszegtomaj: a red and blue shield with a bunch of grapes and a coulter, with a helm, a sun crest and red and blue mantling, above a scroll inscribed CSERSZEGTOMAJ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Cserszegtomaj arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
